name: keepwork-extension-repository
description: Shared Keepwork MCP runtime and application build orchestration

scripts.install:apps: npm ci --include=dev --prefix apps/mcp-runtime && npm ci --prefix apps/vscode-extension && npm ci --prefix apps/local-helper && npm ci --prefix apps/local-model-runtime && npm ci --prefix apps/aichat-desktop && npm ci --prefix apps/pet-companion && npm run prepare:runtime --prefix apps/pet-companion
scripts.check:shared: tsc -p ./ --noEmit && npm run check:layout && npm run check:aichat-runtime
scripts.check:all: npm run check:shared && npm run check --prefix apps/vscode-extension && npm run check --prefix apps/local-model-runtime && npm test --prefix apps/local-model-runtime && npm run check --prefix apps/local-helper && npm run check --prefix apps/aichat-desktop && npm run check:rust:all
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check --manifest-path apps/mcp-rust/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/mcp-rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path apps/mcp-rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:rust:quick: npm run check:aichat-runtime:packaged && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/aichat-rust && cargo check --locked --manifest-path apps/mcp-rust/Cargo.toml && cargo check --locked --manifest-path apps/aichat-rust/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features dev-bins
scripts.check:rust:desktop: pnpm --prefix apps/aichat-rust check && pnpm --prefix apps/aichat-rust smoke
scripts.check:rust:all: npm run check:rust && npm run check:rust:desktop && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:rust-validation: node --test scripts/contract/harness-reference.test.cjs scripts/sync-aichat-runtime.test.cjs scripts/aichat-runtime-build.test.mjs scripts/aichat-runtime-freshness.test.cjs scripts/rust-validation-evidence.test.cjs scripts/rust-validation-workflows.test.cjs apps/mcp-rust/scripts/package-runtime.test.cjs apps/mcp-rust/scripts/smoke.test.cjs
scripts.test:contract: npm run build:mcp-rust && node scripts/build-node-reference.cjs && node --test scripts/contract/*.test.cjs
